questions.question: If the electric field intensity is given by \(E = (xu_{x}+yu_{y}+zu_{z})\) volt/m, the potential difference between X(2,0,0) and Y(1,2,3) is
questions.explanation: \[\begin{aligned} V &=-\int \vec{E} \cdot \vec{d} \mid \\ &=-\left[\int_{1}^{2} x d x \vec{u}_{x}+\int_{2}^{0} y d y \vec{u}_{y}+\int_{3}^{0} z d z \vec{u}_{z}\right] \\ &=-\left[\left.\frac{x^{2}}{2}\right|_{1} ^{2}+\left.\frac{y^{2}}{2}\right|_{2} ^{0}+\left.\frac{z^{2}}{2}\right|_{3}\right] \\ &=-\frac{1}{2}\left[2^{2}-1^{2}+0^{2}-2^{2}+0^{2}-3^{2}\right] \\ &=-\frac{1}{2} x-10=5 \mathrm{V} \end{aligned}\]
